tagline:
Archive your dream today.
Break it into steps you can do.
spoken: [hook] Your morning gets decided the night before. || If you wake up and only then decide what to do, your best hour goes to emails and your phone, and the important thing slides to later. || [turn] So before bed, take two minutes and write down tomorrow's three things. Just three. || Then move the one that actually moves your goal to the top. Say you're switching careers. First thing tomorrow, one hour on your portfolio, before you open any messages. || And set up the start tonight. Leave the file open and the laptop on the desk, so in the morning you just sit down and keep going. || Studying for an exam? Same thing. Tonight you write, chapter four practice questions, first thing at seven, and you leave the book open on that page. || [land] So by the time the day gets busy, the most important thing is already done. || [outro] That's what Dmyor is for. You archive your dream today, so you can see it tomorrow, and break it down into small steps you can actually do. || [outro] If you want to try it out, I've put the link in the bio.
